summary.en: Whole – part – whole on the thread: three glass cards hang on strands from the spine; one card grows in place to 1.45 × with its rows arriving, its strand following its left edge, while the others step back; handing over, the next grows as the previous shrinks.
summary.zh: 线上的总–分–总：三张玻璃卡用细丝挂在主干上；其中一张原地放大到 1.45 倍、各行依次出现，细丝跟着它的左边，其余两张退后变暗；交接时下一张变大、上一张同时缩小。

fits: Three things a product keeps (memory, decisions, files) shown together and then one by one.
notFor: More than three cards; cards whose rows need more than two seconds each.

intent.en: Show the parts without losing the whole: the zoom never returns to an empty frame between parts.
intent.zh: 看部分时不丢掉整体：放大在两张卡之间从不回到空画面。

content.en: Nothing to read in the move: which card is enlarged (from, to).
content.zh: 动作本身没有字：放大哪一张（from、to）。

fits.zh: 产品保存的三样东西（记忆、决定、文件）先一起看、再一张张看。

notFor.zh: 超过三张卡；每行都要读两秒以上的卡。

pairs.note: the scene that runs it three times

en: Grow in place on the strand; flying the card to the centre cuts it off its strand.
Hand over by growing and shrinking together; zooming out to three and back in again doubles the length.
zh: 在细丝上原地放大；把卡飞到画面中央会把它和细丝扯断。
交接时一张变大一张变小同时进行；先退回三张再放大另一张会让时长翻倍。
